review_scope: Original marketing image inspected before authoring; actual browser normal view, matched v2/v3 body macro and original/v3 comparison inspected with vision.
bounded_passes: One material pass plus one visual correction. No geometry or other feature edits.
initial_issue: Square perimeter normal texture stretched grains into directional streaks; first-pass images retained.
final_macro_verdict: Clear meaningful material upgrade from printed-wave appearance to granular pitted stone; good broad front/side consistency. Exact individual grain tracing cannot be certified by screenshot alone; shared object-coordinate UV test passes.
final_normal_view_verdict: Qualified pass for visibly granular sandy mineral. Bedding subordinate but some directional marks remain. Coarse even grain can appear procedural.
original_likeness_limit: Not a close recreation: final is pale peach/beige sandy stone under unchanged lighting; original has richer terracotta/ochre and stronger irregular branching strata. No additional iteration after bounded correction.
parent_review: Independent parent review required before final user acceptance.
